§3§lPurpose and operation§r
The Wireless Energy Monitor reads wireless grid energy and power changes. It accepts and outputs no EU, stores no EU internally, and needs no power supply. Data updates every §1100 ticks (5 seconds)§r over a §1300-second§r history window.

§3§lPreparation and quest§r
The crafting-table recipe requires §14§r LV Sensors, §12§r Steel Plates, §11§r LV Machine Hull and §12§r Steel Screws. This quest detects §11§r monitor and §2does not consume it§r.

§3§lChunk loading§r
Keep the monitor chunk loaded. If the gap between updates exceeds §1200 ticks (10 seconds)§r, the monitor clears trend samples and delays redstone checks by §1600 ticks (30 seconds)§r. Shorter gaps retain the samples. This handles unloading or gaps without updates, rather than loss of power.
